label: Ridgeline Native Full Audit
basis: Native app audit of 0.1.33 (source 91cc6eb) and the user's loading diagnostics from the build before 0.1.33: cache escape starts 362 vs disk hits 166; HTTP cache writes dropped 17; late prepared-cache wins 63; vector tiles decoded 260 for 39 tiles; line packets rejected/re-sent 844; oldest uncanceled HTTP call 65 s.
changes: P1 disk first: only a tile whose own disk read is late (40 ms running, or 250 ms queued while the disk makes progress) also starts a cache-free download; its disk read stays queued and can still win. Removed the 30 s cooldown that skipped the disk for every tile after one slow read.

P3 overlays: each vector-tile layer is decoded once per tile; zooms that enable a layer decode only that layer. The last three styled zoom bands per tile are reused. Overlay styling and line-packet threads run at normal priority instead of background.

P4 derived caches: source and prepared-terrain/composition writes are bounded by bytes (8 MiB / 24 MiB) instead of 8 jobs; HTTP cache publisher limit 8 to 24 MiB; prepared-cache shortcut waits 40 ms instead of 12 ms (continuation, no worker blocked).
P5 render thread and input thread at THREAD_PRIORITY_DISPLAY, above the decode workers.
P7 manifest also handles screenLayout, smallestScreenSize, uiMode, keyboard and navigation changes, so dark-mode or split-screen changes no longer recreate the activity and reload the map.

B1 uncaptured GPU errors are counted and logged instead of panicking (release builds abort on panic); tile lookups that could panic on a stale cover row (routes terrain_height, progressive interiors, seams, picking, draw rows, adaptive levels) are checked.
B2 a line packet the renderer refuses is retried with back-off (250 ms doubling to 30 s) instead of every frame.
B3 resuming a partial offline region uses the region's own overlay choice (now stored in its metadata; older regions default to included).
B7 connection warm-up HEAD requests no longer stay in HTTP diagnostics; spans of finished calls never delivered are pruned after 30 s.
Diagnostics: disk-won escapes, late disk reads, derived cache writes written/dropped, GPU errors recorded.

tests.kotlinJvm: 196 tests, 0 failures (new: BoundedWritesTest x3, IncrementalDecodeTest on a real LINZ tile, per-tile disk escape test)
